item.title: REF 0.15.0
item.description:
• PAIN now shows beside each song's LUFS: how loud and harsh it sounds to the ear (perceived loudness raised by sharpness). Higher means louder or harsher. Rest the pointer on it to see what it means.
  • A reference set shows its songs' median PAIN, next to the set's LUFS.
  • The REF plug-in shows PAIN too.
